title: Introduction to Critical Thinking and Logic: Main Exam, 31 December 2021
unitTitle: Introduction to Critical Thinking and Logic
instructions: ANSWER QUESTION ONE AND ANY OTHER TWO QUESTIONS

parts.text: Explain what you understand by creative thinking and elaborate on the characteristics of a creative person.
Giving one example for each, distinguish between a valid argument and a sound argument.
What do you understand by major, minor and middle terms of a syllogism?

items.text: What do you understand by definition? Using examples, discuss any four types of definitions.
Using the traditional square of opposition, show the relationship between the various categories of propositions.
Construct syllogisms for the following mood and figure.
Identify the three categories of fallacies, and use two examples from each to explain these categories.
